item.title: JCPenney closing store at Pleasanton mall early next year
item.description: The JCPenney store at Stoneridge Shopping Center will be closing its doors in February due to the retailer’s inability to continue its lease. Meanwhile, property owner 3VG teased “a promising new-to-market tenant” is coming to the mall soon. The post JCPenney closing store at Pleasanton mall early next year appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: Letter: Pleasanton pianist brings music therapy to memory care
item.description: “The Tri-Valley thrives on practical ideas that help families. Here is one we can grow: regular performances in senior communities, libraries, farmers markets and more schools connecting students to their community so kids see a clearer purpose to their education.” The post Letter: Pleasanton pianist brings music therapy to memory care appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: New parking lot at Lions Wayside opens in time for holiday shopping
item.description: The city of Pleasanton recently finished construction of a new parking lot located right next to the renovated Lions Wayside Park, according to a city newsletter. The post New parking lot at Lions Wayside opens in time for holiday shopping appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: Bella Roma Pizzeria in Livermore back on the market
item.description: The longstanding Bella Roma Pizzeria in Livermore is currently up for sale, following its purchase last year by current ownership, restaurant representatives confirmed to Livermore Vine. item.title: Livermore mom saves local yarn shop
item.description: “My passion is about building the community as well as elevating the yarn shop experience,” Sanjani Ramkissoon said of opening the new yarn store Stitch & Revel this year in Livermore. The post Livermore mom saves local yarn shop appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: Pleasanton man, accused of driving 150+ mph, pleads not guilty in fatal Crow Canyon crash
item.description: A Pleasanton man has been arraigned for murder and other charges for allegedly killing a passenger in another vehicle while driving drunk at well over 100 mph on Crow Canyon Road in San Ramon last weekend. The post Pleasanton man, accused of driving 150+ mph, pleads not guilty in fatal Crow Canyon crash appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: Foothill swimmer Mijatovic wins in record-setting fashion at U.S. Open Championships
item.description: Luka Mijatovic, the 16-year-old from Foothill High School in Pleasanton, set the swimming world on fire Saturday night by winning the 800-meter freestyle title by over three seconds at the Toyota U.S. Open Championships. item.description: CHP continues to investigate the afternoon commute crash on Interstate 580 last week that killed a Pleasanton native and emergency room technician who had his eyes set on engagement and nursing school.
